item.title: From AI Prototype to Production: What Makes AI Project Delivery Different?
item.description:
Building an AI prototype is one thing. Turning it into a reliable, production-ready system is another.

As organizations move from isolated demos to production-grade generative AI and agentic workflows, the challenge increasingly extends beyond model capability to delivery discipline, operational reliability, and measurable business value.

1. Start with the business problem, not the model

Not every workflow benefits from AI. Effective scoping starts with a clearly defined use case, measurable success criteria, and a baseline benchmark—comparing proposed AI performance against simpler rule-based automation or existing human workflows before committing engineering capacity.

item.title: Four AI Assistants, One Question: How Differently Do They Respond?
item.description:
Most AI comparisons focus on benchmarks, coding abilities, reasoning or productivity.

I wanted to try something different.

What happens when four AI assistants receive the same simple question, without detailed instructions, technical requirements or an expected answer?

I asked ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity:

What if you become human for a day? What would you do?

It’s a hypothetical question with no objectively correct answer. That makes it interesting: each assistant has room to interpret the question and decide what to emphasize.

item.title: Two Websites, One System: How I Architected My Portfolio Without Letting AI Run the Project
item.description:
There is a version of this project where I open ChatGPT or GitHub Copilot, type “build me a portfolio website,” and publish whatever comes back. The result might even look polished.

That is not how I approached it.

Generating a website is one thing. Understanding its architecture, maintaining its code and managing future changes is another.

I wanted to treat my websites as software projects, not one-off design exercises. That meant defining requirements, making architectural decisions, organizing content and using AI to support implementation rather than letting it make those decisions for me.
